Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of labor and industries to set child labor law administration fees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing fees to administer child laborlaws; and adding a new section to chapter 49.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall set and establish fees for the administrationand enforcement of the requirements of RCW 49.12.121 or 49.12.123 or arule or order adopted under RCW 49.12.121 or 49.12.123.
